title: Performance Marketer
description:
**\*\* Company Name:** Klizo Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**\*\* Company Website:** www.klizos.com  
\***\* Position Title:** Growth Marketer / Performance Marketer  
**\*\* No. of Vacancies**: **1**   
**\*\* Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**\*\* Location:** PS Abacus, Newtown, Akanksha More **(Near City Centre 2\).**  
**\*\* Job Type:** IN OFFICE  
**\*\* Experience Required:** 3 **\- 6Years**  
**\*\* Shift Time: 12\.00 PM \- 9\.00 PM** (Need to be **flexible** with other shifts as well. **Drop service is available for shifts ending after 11 PM. )**

**Role Overview :**

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Executive who can help drive user acquisition, lead generation, brand visibility, and campaign execution across our software products and client projects.

This role is ideal for someone who is creative, analytical, fast\-moving, and comfortable using modern digital tools to test ideas, create campaigns, and improve results quickly.

The person should be able to think beyond traditional marketing and actively experiment with new channels, content formats, outreach methods, automation tools, and growth strategies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for SaaS products **(Interview Screener, Spectosoft etc.)**,websites, and client projects.
* Research **target customers, competitors, buyer personas, and industry trends.**
* Create and manage content ideas for **LinkedIn, email campaigns, landing pages, ads, blogs, and social platforms.**
* **Support lead generation** through LinkedIn, email outreach, communities, directories, partnerships, and other channels.
* Work with design and development teams to **improve landing pages, conversion flows, and marketing funnels.**
* **Track campaign performance** and **report on leads, conversions, engagement, traffic,** and other **growth metrics.**
* Test different **messaging, offers, headlines, audiences, and channels to improve results.**
* Use marketing **automation, CRM, analytics, and productivity tools to speed up execution.**
* Help create go\-to\-market plans for new products and features.
* Coordinate with internal teams to turn product updates into marketing campaigns.

**Required Skills:**

* **3 – 6 years of experience** in digital marketing, growth marketing, performance marketing, or SaaS marketing.
* Strong understanding of LinkedIn marketing, email outreach, SEO basics, landing pages, and social media campaigns.
* Good writing **skills for ads, posts, emails, website copy, and campaign messages.**
* Ability to research markets and understand customer pain points.
* Comfortable working with modern marketing tools, automation platforms, analytics tools, and content creation tools.
* **Basic understanding of funnels**, conversion rates, lead generation, and campaign testing.
* **Strong communication** skills and ability to work with design, development, and sales teams.
* Self\-starter attitude with the ability to move fast and test new ideas.

**Preferred Skills :**

* **Experience marketing SaaS products, B2B software, HR tech, recruiting tools, security software, AI tools, or business platforms.**
* Experience with **LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Instantly, Lemlist, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Ads, Google Ads**, or similar tools.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools for research, content drafting, campaign planning, automation, or productivity.
* Basic Canva, Figma, or design coordination experience.
* Basic knowledge of SEO, paid ads, email deliverability, and cold outreach.
* Ability to create simple campaign reports and explain what is working or not working.

**Success Metrics:**

The person in this role will be measured by:

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Improvement in website traffic and conversion rates.
* Campaigns launched per month.
* LinkedIn/email outreach performance.
* Content consistency and quality.
* Speed of execution and ability to test new ideas.
* Contribution to product growth and brand visibility.

**Ideal Candidate:**

The ideal candidate is not just a traditional marketer. We want someone who is curious, resourceful, and comfortable experimenting.

They should be able to take a product, understand the target customer, create campaign ideas, test channels, use tools to move faster, and keep improving based on results.

This person should enjoy figuring out how to get attention, generate leads, and create momentum for software products.

**Interested candidates** are requested to **send us** their **updated CV** through **indeed.com** or **email us** at **jobs@klizos.com** for scheduling interview with us.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

* Provident Fund

title: Student Counselor
description:
**Why this role exists**

Cheenta teaches students across India and abroad, from Grade 1 math circles toOlympiad, ISI\-CMI entrance and research programs. Our faculty are mathematicians andphysicists, and the classes are strong. What happens between classes is uneven.

A student who misses two homework sets, or a parent who does not know which contestcomes next, quietly drifts away. We want one person who knows each child's account andacts before that happens.

Research on student coaching is clear on one point: proactive, personal contact from askilled adult improves persistence, and automated reminders alone do not. This role isthat adult.

**What you will do**

* Review each student's account regularly: attendance, homework, test performanceand faculty feedback.
* Follow up on homework and practice, and work with faculty when a student needsextra support or more challenge.
* Notice students who are losing momentum and step in early.
* Keep students and parents informed about upcoming contests, registrations,scholarships, camps and other opportunities, and advise which ones suit each child.
* Hold regular counseling sessions with students and parents, and share clear, specificprogress updates.
* Guide families at renewal time on progress so far and the right next program.
* Work with the Panini8 team to improve the tools counselors use, and help shape thecounseling function as it grows.

**Who we are looking for (Must have)**

* Prior experience working directly with school\-age students and their parents as acounselor, academic advisor, academic coordinator or in student support.
* Experience looking after many students at once on a regular contact schedule, notonly walk\-in support.
* Fluent, warm spoken and written English; Bengali as a second language.
* Comfort with data: reads a student dashboard, keeps clean records, notices patterns.
* The judgment to tell a parent something they may not want to hear, kindly and clearly.
* Willingness to work weekends and the 11:30 am to 8:30 pm schedule.
* A degree in any discipline. You do not need to solve Olympiad problems, but you mustbe at ease around mathematics and the people who do it.

**Good to have**

* Knowledge of the Olympiad and entrance pathways in India (IOQM to INMO, ISI, CMI)or the US (AMC to AIME).
* Experience with families outside India.
* Training in counseling, psychology or education.
* A background as a teacher who moved into student support.
* Interest in growing into university admissions counseling.

**What this role is not**

* **Not sales:** Admissions converts new leads. You serve enrolled students, and you mayadvise a family to pause or leave.
* **Not teaching:** Faculty decide content, homework and levels. You make sure theirdecisions reach the student and get done.
* **Not a helpdesk:** Admin handles payments, links and scheduling queries. You are not the first line for support.
* **Not clinical counseling:** You will notice stress and burnout and raise it with parents,but you do not provide therapy.

**Terms and how to apply**

* **Compensation:** ₹35,000–45,000 per month, based on experience.
* **Working hours:** 11:30 am to 8:30 pm. Saturday and Sunday are working days.
* **Time off:** one weekly off, plus statutory holidays.
* **Benefits:** health insurance and lunch at the office.
* **Growth:** counselors who do well may be trained and moved up to universityadmissions counseling through Cheenta Reflect.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
